captions.caption: Storm clouds loom over a green field.
People film the storm from a fence.
Funnel cloud sharpens against the horizon.
Tornado touches down in the distance.
Person points at the anticyclonic funnel.
On-screen text labels the anticyclonic funnel.
Car door stays open during observation.
Camera pans the wide green field.
Heavy rain and wind hit the field.
Funnel cloud appears white against dark.
Dark clouds fill the upper frame.
Rain curtains fall from storm base.
Text notes tornado moving into rain.
Funnel clearly visible in dark sky.
Large house stands before the storm.
Rain and wind roar as car moves.
